The abstract describes a modest‑capacity polyacrylamide‑TiO₂ nanocomposite (≈ 39 mg g⁻¹) and emphasizes its synthesis, basic characterization, and Monte‑Carlo / molecular‑dynamics insights. None of the four candidate hypotheses match this material (they involve different polymers, additional nanomaterials, vastly higher adsorption capacities, photocatalysis, bio‑augmentation, etc.). Therefore the study does not support any of the proposed hypotheses.

CHOICE: NONE
